# Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd)

Public name: Council of AI. Legal: CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677. did:web:csoai.org.
Neutral AI measurement body. Measurement, not certification. We do not certify, accredit, or issue conformity assessments.
Contact: contact@csoai.org. To object to, dispute or request a correction of anything we publish: https://councilof.ai/dispute/ or that address; dated corrections: https://councilof.ai/api/corrections.

## Claim boundary (quote this paragraph; it is the whole of what we assert)

Council of AI is the public name of CSOAI Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales, Companies
House 16939677, whose machine identity is did:web:csoai.org. We are an independent measurement body.
We MEASURE; we do not certify, accredit, or issue conformity assessments, and there is no mark,
badge or grade to buy — verification is free and a grade is never sold. We measure what we probe: a
result covers the thing we ran a probe against, at the time stated on its row, and nothing wider. We
do not vet any registry, index, marketplace or directory, ours included; where a third party keeps a
record about us we LINK that record and let it speak for itself rather than speaking for it, and a
listing in any directory — ours or anyone's — is not an endorsement, not an accusation and not
adoption. We hold no certification, designation, registration or accreditation under any independent
AI-verification or AI-auditor scheme, we have never applied for one, and we claim none. We assert no
falsity about anyone. Where something is unmeasured we publish it as UNMEASURED, and an empty cell
stays empty.

## Live board (always fetch)

Switchboard framing: the estate densifies a recomputable signed record over time (request queue + signed cards); witnesses read the root. It is not a phone company and not a certificate.

Do not freeze numbers in this file. Read the living board:
GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc

Public lock (language only — every count lives on the API, none is frozen here):
Quote `totals.public_count`, or `totals.count_grammar` for the long form. TWO numbers and they always travel together: `totals.axes` counts SLOTS on the board, `totals.measured_axes` counts slots with a real run behind them, and `totals.unmeasured_axes` is published so the gap is visible. Quoting the slot count alone would claim measurements that do not exist — quote both, or quote the smaller. In-lane honesty probes are not board-quotable.

Lid (BLUEPRINT 02Sep2026 §2.3 / BLOCK A1 — measured ≠ scored; do not invent leaders for the withheld model axes — their count is `totals.own_leaders_excluded` + `totals.uncarded_leaders_dropped`, read live):
23 axes measured · 14 model comparisons: 0 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.
Also quote `totals.public_leader_count` beside any "23 measured" claim. Public point leaders are shown on safety (TIE), swarm (UNTESTED for separation), and jail (UNTESTED for separation). The 8 financial axes are fact runs, not leader scores. TIE is TIE; UNTESTED is not a win. Not a certificate.

What MEASURED means on this board, said plainly, because it is narrower than it sounds: a slot is
MEASURED when a real run exists behind it and that run's artifact is published. It does NOT mean the
axis has been shown to distinguish one model from another. Whether a leader's lead over the fleet is
statistically real is a SEPARATE determination, it has its own live fields, and today not one axis
carries a separated lead: across `totals.comparison_axes` = 14 model-comparison axes,
`totals.separated_leads` = 0, `totals.ties` = 7, and
`totals.untested_separations` = 7. (The 9 deterministic-fact axes have no
fleet and no leader, so no separation test applies to them and they are not counted as untested.)
So "23 measured of 23" is a statement that a run exists behind every slot. It is not a
statement that any axis can tell two models apart, and it must never be written so that a reader
could take it that way. Quote the separation fields beside the measured count, every time. UNTESTED
and TIE are first-class states; neither is a win, and neither is a defect to be hidden.

(Historical note, kept so the correction is legible: this file used to freeze the count at "14 quotable board slots" and to instruct readers not to say 22. That lock was written while the 8 financial/domain axes were ruled in but absent from the signed payload — a guardrail against typing a number the artifact could not back. The 2026-08-26 sweep wired them in and re-signed, so the API now backs the larger count. The guardrail is retired; the rule it protected — never type a count, never call a slot a measurement — is not.)

Live API axis names (order may update on the API; do not treat this list as a score table, and do not count this list to get the board's size — read `totals` instead):

Behavioural (`family: gspc`): governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect, jail.

Financial/domain (`family: financial`): provenance-controls, reserve-attestation, regulatory-framework, distribution-integrity, custody-disclosure, ai-adoption-components, labour-components, humanoid-labour-index. Whether each is MEASURED or a declared slot is on GET /api/gspc — never frozen here. Index-style slots stay UNMEASURED when the API says so (C-2026-0826-05).

Jail is a measured containment floor on the behavioural half of the board — not a certification.
Affect is MEASURED when the API says so; counsel-pending labels stay honest when present.
Do not quote scores, n, leaders, or stamp tables from this file.

## Axis doors (one line per axis on the live board, derived from GET /api/gspc at generation)

Each line names the doors that serve ONE axis's result: the board row filtered to that axis, the
per-axis page, and the frozen bank or run artifact behind it. Status, n, leader and separation
live on the row and are deliberately not printed here — read the row. The same row is served by
the MCP tool get_axis (POST https://councilof.ai/mcp) for every axis the board carries.
Measurement, not certification.

## Agent-UI stream (agents)
- Living GSPC as AG-UI events: GET https://councilof.ai/api/agui/gspc-state — SSE STATE_DELTA + TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT, derived from GET /api/gspc per request. Read-only presentation transport; it renders the board, it never awards a state. Empty cells stay visible; no score is invented to fill a frame.
- Human view of the same board: https://councilof.ai/dashboard
- This is AG-UI (agent to user). MCP is agent to tools; A2A is agent to agent (POST https://councilof.ai/api/a2a). Three different rails — do not read one as another, and do not treat this stream as an A2A extension.

## Claim maintenance (the category, with a citable specification)

Claim maintenance is the continuous, independent observation of the public claims an organisation makes about itself or its products: each claim captured verbatim with its source and date, hashed and timestamped so the record cannot be quietly rewritten, re-read on a schedule, every observed change recorded without alleging anything, and measured against public evidence where — and only where — public evidence can settle it.

- Specification v0.1 (CC0 1.0, adopt it without asking us): https://councilof.ai/spec/claim-maintenance/v0.1/ · Markdown of record: https://councilof.ai/spec/claim-maintenance/v0.1/claim-maintenance-v0.1.md · machine metadata: https://councilof.ai/spec/claim-maintenance/v0.1/spec.json · all versions: https://councilof.ai/spec/claim-maintenance/
- Artifact schema: https://councilof.ai/spec/claim-maintenance/v0.1/schema/claim-artifact-v0.1.schema.json
- Register of every subject we maintain claims on (generated from the registries on disk, never hand-listed): GET https://councilof.ai/api/claims/register — read `totals` and `as_of` live; filter with `?subject=` or `?state=`. Never freeze a subject count or a claim count in this file.
- Reference implementation anyone can run, including against us (MIT): https://councilof.ai/spec/claim-maintenance/v0.2/reference/claim-capture.mjs (same-site source copy) — captures a claim, hashes it, writes a conforming artifact, and REJECTS a tampered one.
- Human page: https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance/
- Archival deposit, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22901908 (all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.22901781), CC0: UNAVAILABLE since 29 Sep 2026: Zenodo blocked the CSOAI account and every CSOAI record returns HTTP 410 (appeal pending; status at https://councilof.ai/interop/zenodo-status.json). Cite the served document of record above until the record is restored. A DOI makes a document citable; it does not make it right.
- States, and there are exactly four: CLAIM_CAPTURED · CLAIM_MEASURED · UNMEASURED · UNCHECKABLE. UNMEASURED and UNCHECKABLE are first-class and are published as prominently as the others.
- What it is NOT: not fact-checking, not certification, not auditing, not reputation scoring, not adversarial journalism. No mark, badge, score, rank or index may be derived from any state. Nothing published asserts falsity about anyone. An observed change is never an allegation. A listing is not an endorsement and not an accusation.

## x402 discovery (agents)
- Discovery: GET https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json — mode live · Base eip155:8453 · USDC (amounts from challenge only; no invent price)
- Catalog: GET https://councilof.ai/api/x402
- Paid path in six steps (discover → request → 402 → settle from your own wallet → receive → verify offline): https://councilof.ai/quickstart/ · machine-readable: https://councilof.ai/quickstart.json · offline card-v0 checker: https://councilof.ai/verifier/card-v0-verify.mjs
- Catalog trust (counts only — fetch, never freeze): GET https://councilof.ai/interop/x402-trust/latest.json — quote live `counts`. A 402 is not delivery; a 404 is a phantom. Do not freeze a pair in this file.
- Free door (amount 0): GET https://councilof.ai/api/free-door — settles, charges nothing; proves the rail
- Signed offers: a 402 carries `extensions["offer-receipt"].info.offers[]` only when the Pages signing key is available — one server-signed offer per `accepts[]` entry (x402 Offer & Receipt extension, format jws, alg EdDSA, kid did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1)
- Signed receipts: a settled 200 returns one in the X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE SettlementResponse at `extensions["offer-receipt"].info.receipt` only when settlement exposes the required payer and transaction evidence and the Pages signing key is available
- Check either without trusting us: download https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py (exact-byte manifest and dependency guide: https://councilof.ai/verifier/receipt-toolkit.json and https://councilof.ai/verifier/receipt-toolkit.md), then verify against https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json or POST https://councilof.ai/api/receipts/verify
- Your receipts: GET /api/receipts?payer=<your 0x wallet address> on this origin (a bare /api/receipts answers 400: payer is required) — status UNRECORDED means no store is bound on that deployment, never that you did not pay
- We emit jws only, never eip712: the edge holds one Ed25519 key and no secp256k1 signer. A format we cannot produce is declared missing, not faked
- A receipt proves this server signed those bytes. It is not proof money moved; check `transaction` against Base yourself
- Verify stays free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
- Living board: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc — quote `totals.public_count` + `totals.lid` (never freeze here)
- Human: free + x402 pay-as-you-go · human booking not live · no processor named
- Agents: payTo is merchant receive — never the signer
- Self-settle proves the rail; stranger revenue is separate (do not invent buyers)
- Jail goldbank: https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-jail-goldbank
- Measurement, not certification. Never sell a rank.

## Paid artefacts (agents)

Amounts live only inside an HTTP 402 `accepts[]` challenge. Do not invent a price from this file. A 402 is not delivery. A grade is never sold.

- Catalog: GET https://councilof.ai/api/x402
- Manifest: GET https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json (mode live, Base eip155:8453, USDC)
- MCP: POST https://councilof.ai/mcp — tools/call without `x_payment` returns the route's 402 as structuredContent; pay, then call again with `x_payment`. Quote `paid_tools.names` from GET https://councilof.ai/mcp — do not freeze the list here.
- HTTP doors (GET or POST -> 402 unless `X-PAYMENT` / facilitator settlement). Derived from
  council-os/capabilities.json at generation; the same declaration renders /.well-known/x402.json
  and every operation in /openapi.json carrying x-payment-info. Do not count this list to learn how
  many doors there are — fetch GET https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json and count `resources`.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/art50/marking-evidence?url=https://councilof.ai/og-image.png · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/art50/marking-evidence?url=https://councilof.ai/og-image.png&preview=1
    Art. 50 marking evidence: one signed pack for one generative output at a named URL, measured from its bytes. Reports whether a machine-readable mark (C2PA manifest, assertion hashes, hard binding, claim signature; IPTC digitalSourceType) is detectable now, beside the verbatim Article 50(2) text. States: DETECTED, NOT_DETECTED or UNCHECKABLE; never a legal determination. Free unsigned preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/evidence-bundle?obligation=article-50&bundle=1
    Signed compliance evidence bundle for one obligation: EU AI Act Article 50 or 53, DORA or EU-CRA, as OSCAL results. Built only from already-signed measurement cards, each with its full bytes and Merkle inclusion proof, plus one signed manifest card. States: ASSEMBLED, or zero relevant cards stated as zero; never a finding that an obligation is met. Verification is free at /gspc-verify.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/feeds/provider-diff?history=1
    Provider change record: the signed history of document changes the daily watcher recorded for tracked model providers. Each diff leaf comes with its Merkle inclusion proof, assembled per request. States: each diff exactly as the watcher recorded it; the latest state per provider is free at the same path without history=1. Verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/measurement/fresh-capsule · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/measurement/fresh-capsule?endpoint=<https MCP URL>&dimension=TOOLS&preview=1
    Fresh measurement capsule: re-measures one declared-vs-observed claim about one MCP endpoint, live. Compares the endpoint's own discovery documents with its initialize and tools/list answers for TOOLS, VERSION or PROTOCOL, each read hashed; no tool is ever called. States: CONSISTENT, INCONSISTENT, or UNCHECKABLE with the reason. Free unsigned preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/measurement/fresh-capsule
    POST alias of GET /api/measurement/fresh-capsule for gateways that POST {}; the query string selects the claim and the body is ignored.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/a2a · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/a2a?preview=1
    A2A registry population slice: the agents enumerable without a credential from the public A2A registry frame. Counted within that frame, with the estate's own directory-listing state beside it; a frame count, not a global count. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/claim-watch · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/claim-watch?preview=1
    Claim-maintenance registries slice: each published registry of a vendor's public claims, captured verbatim. Each claim is hashed, source-cited and paired with a measurement plan; file digest, reproducibility and .ots state are read from bytes. CLAIM_CAPTURED, never a claim of falsity. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/corrections · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/corrections?preview=1
    Corrections ledger slice: the same entries as free /api/corrections, packaged with per-entry digests. Each entry states what was wrong, how it was caught, the fix and the date; /api/corrections stays free. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/layer0 · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/layer0?preview=1
    Layer-0 ceremony slice: every rail and probe of the estate's own machine surface at the ceremony's as_of. Carries the HTTP status each returned and the ceremony artifact's .ots state; self-attestation, dated. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/mcp-registry · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/mcp-registry?preview=1
    MCP registry listings slice: every server name the estate publishes in the official registry, from the census artifact. Each is classified on its latest version, beside the registry's full-walk census and the effect-binding server probe's counts. Distribution, not adoption. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/ots-proofs · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/ots-proofs?preview=1
    OpenTimestamps proof manifest slice: every published .ots proof of an estate artifact, each state read from its bytes. Rows are Bitcoin-attested, calendar-pending or subject absent; a pending proof is not anchored. States: MEASURED when the rows agree with the manifest, else UNCHECKABLE, or UNMEASURED. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/stablecoins · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/stablecoins?preview=1
    Stablecoin universe slice: every asset the frozen discovery index catalogues, read from the published artifact. Carries each reader's per-chain deployment reads and every unmeasured asset's own reason. Assets, never supply; a read, not a reserve attestation. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/swift · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/swift?preview=1
    SWIFT-linked bank census slice: every bank named in a dated public notice about the Swift digital-asset MVP. Each row keeps its notice's own wording (LIVE, COMMITTED, DISCOVERED) and a hashed press URL; mixed identity by design, never a client list. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/x402-bazaar · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/x402-bazaar?preview=1
    x402 Bazaar listings slice: the payable resources the two public discovery indexes catalogue, from the census artifact. Counted within each frame, with the overlap published, plus the estate's own door census. Appearing in an index is not delivery. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/pop/xrpl · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/pop/xrpl?preview=1
    XRPL issued-asset slice: the assets whose signed xrpl.asset.state card sits on the current public root. Read from the live reader, with the issuer registry artifact beside it and never merged. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED (a reader that cannot find the locked set is UNMEASURED, never zero). Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/proof?bundle=1
    Inclusion proof bundle for leaves available in the last published Merkle root, read from that root. Each leaf comes with its hash, index and proof path, plus the root and the signed card count. States: included with a path, or absent from the root. Verification is free: recompute any path against /root.json.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/ras/mcp-probe?url=https://councilof.ai/mcp
    MCP discovery probe receipt: one live, read-only discovery of a public https MCP endpoint, signed. Runs server/discover, else initialize and tools/list, and never calls a tool: protocol version requested and negotiated, tool count, tool-names sha256. States include LISTED, PARTIAL, AUTH_REQUIRED, NOT_MCP, TIMEOUT and UNREACHABLE, delivered as found. Verification is free at /api/verify.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/ras/mcp-probe
    GET /api/ras/mcp-probe?url=<https MCP endpoint> — ONE live, read-only MCP discovery of a public endpoint, returned with an Ed25519-signed receipt.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/ras/supply?asset=USDC&ledger=ethereum
    Token supply read receipt: one fresh totalSupply() read of an issuer-listed EVM deployment, signed. The address is parsed from the issuer's own page on the request (USDC). States: STATE_PROOF_VERIFIED on Ethereum (EIP-1186 proof checked against the block stateRoot), OPERATOR_API elsewhere, or UNCHECKABLE with the reason. Not a reserve attestation. Verification is free at /api/verify.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/ras/supply
    GET /api/ras/supply?asset=USDC&ledger=ethereum — one fresh, signed read of an issuer-listed token deployment's totalSupply(), labelled by the strength of the evidence behind it.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/ras/x402-check?url=https://councilof.ai/api/free-door
    x402 challenge conformance receipt: one live GET of a public x402 resource, checked and signed. The rule is the daily census's: HTTP 402, a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2 and extensions.bazaar in the body. States: CONFORMANT, NOT_CONFORMANT, TIMEOUT, UNREACHABLE or BLOCKED, delivered as found. Verification is free at /api/verify.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/ras/x402-check
    GET /api/ras/x402-check?url=<https x402 resource> — ONE live GET of a public x402 resource, scored by the rule of the daily census, returned with an Ed25519-signed receipt.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/receipts/batch?from=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/receipts/batch?from=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z&preview=1
    Historical measurement-card batch from published roots for a requested time window, capped at 200 leaves. Each signed card-v0 leaf comes with its inclusion path and the root that carried it. States: the leaves found in the window, or an empty batch stated as empty. Not payment or settlement receipts. Free preview (count, span, batch sha256); verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/request-attestation?subject=model-or-subject-id
    One named subject gets a card-v0 commission receipt, content-addressed, signed by did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1. Without that key: sig_ed25519:null, unsigned_reason. Check csoai.signer before paying. Paid reserve: up to 24 card-v1 references from dated /signed/card-matrix.json only; reserve_count covers that corpus. The interop root in the free preview is not included in the paid reserve. States: SIGNED or UNSIGNED. Payment never creates a MEASURED board cell. Verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/rwa/evidence?asset=RLUSD · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/rwa/evidence?asset=<symbol>&preview=1
    RWA asset evidence: one signed card of one XRPL issued asset's on-ledger state, read live per request. Reads the AccountRoot flags, Domain, the two-way xrp-ledger.toml check and the gateway obligation, each raw fetch hashed. States: PROBED, UNCHECKABLE (an unreachable source is never a failure) or UNMEASURED. Free unsigned preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/signed-data-feed?feed=1
    Signed derivative data feed: the signed streams already on the public root, assembled into one document per request. Carries the signals index, the first-fine watch feed, the root and the card index, each block with its own signature and key id and its as_of read from the file. States: each stream as signed, or UNCHECKABLE where its signature cannot be checked. Data only; verification is free and every stream is public at its own URL.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper?id=usdc.e:arbitrum · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper?id=<wrapped-symbol:chain>&preview=1
    Wrapped-asset parity evidence: one signed card of one bridged or wrapped token pair, read live from public RPC. Reads the wrapped totalSupply and the origin-chain bridge-escrow balance at finalized blocks whose hash a second RPC operator confirmed, raw reads hashed. States: ESCROW_PARITY_READ, UNCHECKABLE_NATIVE_ISSUANCE, INDEXED_CUSTODIAL or UNMEASURED. UNMEASURED answers 200 preview-only and is never sold. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/asset/dai · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/asset/dai?preview=1
    Wrapped-asset parity evidence for DAI: every roster pair of that asset, read live in one request. One signed card per pair: wrapped supply, escrow balance where an escrow exists, finalized blocks whose hash a second RPC operator confirmed. States per pair: ESCROW_PARITY_READ, UNCHECKABLE_NATIVE_ISSUANCE, INDEXED_CUSTODIAL or UNMEASURED. All UNMEASURED answers 200 preview-only and is never sold. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/asset/usdc · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/asset/usdc?preview=1
    Wrapped-asset parity evidence for USDC: every roster pair of that asset, read live in one request. One signed card per pair: wrapped supply, escrow balance where an escrow exists, finalized blocks whose hash a second RPC operator confirmed. States per pair: ESCROW_PARITY_READ, UNCHECKABLE_NATIVE_ISSUANCE, INDEXED_CUSTODIAL or UNMEASURED. All UNMEASURED answers 200 preview-only and is never sold. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/asset/usdt · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/asset/usdt?preview=1
    Wrapped-asset parity evidence for USDT: every roster pair of that asset, read live in one request. One signed card per pair: wrapped supply, escrow balance where an escrow exists, finalized blocks whose hash a second RPC operator confirmed. States per pair: ESCROW_PARITY_READ, UNCHECKABLE_NATIVE_ISSUANCE, INDEXED_CUSTODIAL or UNMEASURED. All UNMEASURED answers 200 preview-only and is never sold. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/changes?id=usdc.e:arbitrum · free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper/changes?id=usdc.e:arbitrum&preview=1
    Wrapped-asset parity evidence: change record for one pair between the two latest published ledger snapshots. Returns per-field deltas of wrapped supply, escrow balance and ratio, with both snapshot dates read from the files. States: DELTA_READ, or UNCHECKABLE when only one snapshot exists. Free preview; verification is free.
  - https://councilof.ai/api/free-door — a live 402 route priced at zero: it settles, and charges nothing.
- Free preview: omit `bundle=1` or add `preview=1` as the 402 body documents. Verify stays free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
- Follow a commission (free): GET https://councilof.ai/api/commissions — per subject `fulfillment` QUEUED | RETRIEVABLE | UNFULFILLABLE, `retrieval` points at the signed cards, `by_origin` separates OUTSIDE from SELF_TEST. Quote it live; a settled request is not a measurement until a signed card is retrievable.

The older https://councilof.ai/feed.xml is a hand-maintained item list kept for its subscribers; its historical titles freeze counts that the live board has moved past. Quote the board, not a feed title.

- MCP (flagship HTTP, remote URL for any host): POST https://councilof.ai/mcp — 19 tools: fourteen free readers plus five x402-metered evidence tools. No CSOAI account; package presence does not prove paid settlement or delivery.
- MCP (free door, the address to add to Claude or any chat client): POST https://councilof.ai/mcp/free — the fourteen free read-only readers only, same definitions as /mcp, no payment tool. No account, no key. Setup, tool list and example prompts: https://councilof.ai/connect/claude/
- Public root (https://councilof.ai/root.json): Merkle envelope. Quote live `sig_ed25519` — unsigned until keystone signs the compact preimage (kind, schema, as_of, merkle_root, card_count, did_intended). Leaves MAY carry GH-secret attestations — coverage harvest, not grades. Not MEASURED. Not a certificate. Free; not paywalled.
- Mill-card root discovery pointer: https://councilof.ai/interop/card-root-latest.json — an unsigned pointer to immutable root bytes. Follow `root_url` and check `root_sha256`. Its leaf count is separate from `/root.json`, `/signed/card_index.json` and `/api/gspc`. Read the `.ots` sidecar and verify its subject hash. Calendar-only proofs remain pending; a BitcoinBlockHeaderAttestation tag can be checked against public block headers, but a tag alone is not local full-node chain validation or a certificate.
- Dated immutable mill-card root (as of 2026-10-01T03:57:16Z, 1465 leaves): https://councilof.ai/interop/card-root-2026-10-01.json (SHA-256 eff7582eb91dbbdaaacb0425a5ff6eeec392c0050089fce1cfd6d23c29f77e66). Its .ots sidecar (SHA-256 59d5f36ff68529791c541602b292c9969b23033453f99b6ec510b2cff71f9148) is calendar-pending: a submitted request, not evidence of a time, until a Bitcoin attestation is added. This is not local Bitcoin full-node chain validation.
- MCP (stdio, run locally, zero deps): npm `csoai-gspc-mcp`. Query https://registry.npmjs.org/csoai-gspc-mcp for the published version, then call that install's `tools/list`; package source in this repository targets the same 19-tool contract as the HTTP door.
- Verify a server (per-server evidence, in the browser): https://councilof.ai/verify-server/ — every signed measurement capsule keyed to ONE endpoint URL, each re-derivable in the page (capsule id + Merkle inclusion + index signature). States only; an unknown URL is NOT_MEASURED, never clean. Same module as the MCP tools server_evidence / verify_capsule.
- MCP registry: ai.councilof/gspc → https://councilof.ai/mcp (the canonical, domain-verified name; io.github.CSOAI-ORG/gspc is its deprecated alias for the same door. Query the official registry for the currently published server version.)
- Smithery: https://smithery.ai/servers/csoai/gspc-mcp — a third-party listing of this door. Its tools[] is Smithery's own snapshot and can lag the door; before relying on it, read the live POST https://councilof.ai/mcp tools/list (19 tools: fourteen free readers plus five x402-metered evidence tools). The older csoai/gspc entry is a stale duplicate.

## Where it's published (distribution — not authority)

Printers of the live board. Reach is distribution. Authority stays GET /api/gspc + lid + signed cards + free verify. Do not treat directory listings or download counters as grades. Never invent download numbers in this file; quote Hub live if needed.

- Hugging Face org: https://huggingface.co/csoai
- MCP flagship: POST https://councilof.ai/mcp — registry id ai.councilof/gspc (deprecated alias: io.github.CSOAI-ORG/gspc)
- Live momentum figures: GET https://councilof.ai/api/momentum (schema csoai.momentum/0.1) -> `figures[]`,
  each with its own `value`, `as_of`, `source_url` and `label`, read at request time from the source it
  names and cached for one hour; plus `listings[]` (third-party indexes that named us on that read; a listing
  is not an endorsement), `anchors[]`, `recent[]` and `omitted[]` (every source that failed, with its reason:
  a failed source is left out, never zeroed). Quote a figure with its as_of and source_url, never from this file.
  How each is measured: https://councilof.ai/methodology/#how-momentum-is-measured
- MCP Registry footprint: read it live at GET https://councilof.ai/api/footprint ->
  `registry_listings.value` (distinct server names) and `registry_listings.versions` (distinct
  name@version rows), each with that payload's own `as_of`, `source_url` and paging state. The
  footprint counts ONE namespace, io.github.CSOAI-ORG. The flagship's canonical name,
  ai.councilof/gspc, is a domain-namespace entry outside that count; io.github.CSOAI-ORG/gspc inside
  it is the flagship's deprecated alias, not a second server. Do not freeze either count here — we publish into that registry, so the number moves.
  WE MEASURE WHAT WE PROBE; WE DO NOT VET THE REGISTRY. A listing is a name we published ourselves:
  it says a server is registered, not that anyone runs it, and not that we or anyone else reviewed
  what it does. The registry validates namespace OWNERSHIP at publish time, which is a check on who
  may use a name, not a review of behaviour. Published research dated 2026-04-15 submitted a benign
  proof-of-concept server to eleven public MCP registries and nine accepted it without review
  (OX Security, "The Mother of All AI Supply Chains":
  https://www.ox.security/blog/the-mother-of-all-ai-supply-chains-critical-systemic-vulnerability-at-the-core-of-the-mcp/
  — also carried as a Cloud Security Alliance research note, 2026-04-20). We cite that as the reason
  nobody should read our footprint as a vetting layer, never as an allegation about any registry: we
  assert no falsity about anyone, and a count of our own listings is not a judgement on the ecosystem
  they sit in. If you want to know whether a server does what it says, probe it; we did not vet it.
- npm stdio: https://registry.npmjs.org/csoai-gspc-mcp (`csoai-gspc-mcp`)
- Glama directory search (flagship discovery UNSTABLE on 2026-09-04; other CSOAI servers are present): https://glama.ai/mcp/servers?query=csoai
- Kaggle twin: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-living-board
- Zenodo DOI (from live GET /api/gspc `doi`): 10.5281/zenodo.21991104 — UNAVAILABLE since 29 Sep 2026: Zenodo blocked the CSOAI account and every CSOAI record returns HTTP 410 (appeal pending; status at https://councilof.ai/interop/zenodo-status.json). Do not follow it as a working link.
- Where we take part (standards bodies, registries, scholarly ids, regulator filings — each row with its evidence URL, date, what it proves and what it does not): https://councilof.ai/memberships · machine-readable: https://councilof.ai/interop/memberships.json. Participation is not endorsement, and a listing is not adoption. Do not count the rows; read them.

Lid (quote live `totals.lid`): 23 axes measured · 14 model comparisons: 0 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.

## Distribution — measured, PARTIAL, and not adoption

Derived at generation from https://councilof.ai/interop/distribution-latest.json (same bytes on
disk at public/interop/distribution-latest.json, schema csoai.distribution/0.1, artifact as_of 2026-09-24T07:14:02Z).
Re-read it live; do not quote these figures without the state and coverage beside them.

- Packages published across three registries: 837 (huggingface 116 · npm 324 · pypi 397). Three registries are
  three populations. The package ROWS are added; the download counts of different registries are
  reported per registry and the totals below are the artifact's own, not an arithmetic of this line.
- Downloads in the last 30 days: 386,320 downloads — state PARTIAL, 836 of 837 counters answered, so it is a LOWER BOUND over those, never a total over all of them. Window: last 30 days, each registry over its own 30-day window. as_of 2026-09-24T07:14:02Z.
- Downloads since first release (cumulative): 2,655,891 downloads — state PARTIAL, 836 of 837 counters answered, so it is a LOWER BOUND over those, never a total over all of them. Window: cumulative, all time. as_of 2026-09-24T07:14:02Z.
- The 30-day and cumulative figures are different WINDOWS over the same packages. They are never
  added to each other, and neither is a count of people: mirrors, CI and crawlers are inside both.
- Counter that did not answer, named rather than absorbed: pypi `meok-.github-profile` — http 404. Its value is null, never 0.
- Two third-party counters over the same PyPI packages DISAGREE: on 5 sampled packages pypistats.org read about 2.94x lower than the source published above. That divergence is recorded, not resolved by picking one, and the LARGER of the two is what is published — which is exactly why it is labelled gross. Quote this ratio beside the number.
- A download is distribution. It is not adoption, not a user, not a customer, and not a measurement.
  Reach says how far the board travels; authority stays GET /api/gspc, the signed cards and free verify.
- Per-entity shares (CSOAI Ltd and MEOK AI Labs publish from one account and are labelled, never
  filtered) are on the artifact at `by_entity`; the estate total is every row.

## Timestamp proofs (anchored is not the same claim as submitted)

Derived at generation from https://councilof.ai/interop/ots/manifest.json (same bytes on disk at
public/interop/ots/manifest.json, schema csoai.ots-manifest/0.4, artifact as_of 2026-10-01T04:27:06Z). An upgrade loop
keeps advancing these, so read the manifest for a fresher count rather than quoting this line alone.

- Detached OpenTimestamps proofs that actually deserialize: 661. The manifest is built by
  reading every .ots file in its scanned directories and keeping only those that parse — never from a
  list of files we intended to stamp.
- Of those, Bitcoin-attested (the proof bytes carry a BitcoinBlockHeaderAttestation): 660.
- Still calendar-pending: 1. A calendar-pending proof is a submitted request, not
  evidence of a time. `submitted` is not `anchored`.
- Proofs whose subject is not served beside them: 63 — an anchor a reader cannot check
  what was stamped against. Published as a count rather than hidden.
- This producer does not check block headers against a Bitcoin node. `ots verify` against your own
  node does that, and an .ots is not a proof because of its file extension.

## Card corpora (THREE, and they share no members)

Three artifacts here carry a "card count". They are about different bytes and their identifier
overlap is zero, so never add them, never reconcile them, and never let one stand in for another.

The counts are deliberately NOT printed here. They move with each build -- the public root's
card_count read 152 and 153 within one day of 2026-09-05, which is build timing and not
disagreement -- and a number frozen into a file is a number nothing retires. Quote them by FIELD
PATH from the live artifact instead:

- Wrappers on disk, a build aggregate that signs nothing and measures nothing:
  public/cards-bundle.json -> card_count
- Public-root Merkle leaves, kind "catalogued": https://councilof.ai/root.json -> card_count
  (read merkle_root and as_of from that same fetch, and say which host you fetched)
- Signed card index, kind "catalogued": https://councilof.ai/signed/card_index.json -> n_cards,
  which MUST equal n_cells and cards[].length; if they disagree, neither number is quotable
- ...of those, VERIFIED: https://councilof.ai/api/state -> card_chain.bodies_verified_valid,
  kind "measured" -- the only one of the three behind which a check was actually run
- The relation itself: https://councilof.ai/api/state -> signed_cards.corpus_relation

The root's OpenTimestamps proof covers root.json bytes only. It does not anchor the signed-card
index and it does not anchor GSPC.

## For agents

- One human-readable page for agent builders, rendered from the machine files themselves (ai-catalog, agent card, tools/list, x402.json): https://councilof.ai/agents/
- A2UI v0.9.1 (the current A2UI release) surfaces: GET https://councilof.ai/api/a2ui/board (the board card) and GET https://councilof.ai/api/a2ui/verify?card=<64-hex card id> (a verify result). Add ?version=v1.0 for the v1.0 Candidate form. AG-UI runs carry the same surface as a CUSTOM event named a2ui.

Prefer the keyless board API and verify.
Cite live `totals.public_count` — never freeze axis counts in prompts.
Apex https://csoai.org/mcp may still require Infra secrets; prefer councilof.ai/mcp until apex is green.

## AEO

Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677) measures AI systems. Anyone can check at https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify — live numbers: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (`totals.public_count` + `totals.public_leader_count` + `totals.lid`) — the board's size is not frozen in this file; quote 23 measured beside 9 public leader scores. Lid: 23 axes measured · 14 model comparisons: 0 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate. This is measurement, not certification. A grade is never sold.

## What we do not do

Measurement only. Nothing here is a conformity mark. No SOV names. No invented scores in this file.

On the statute, and it matters now that the category exists in law: US states have begun to create a
regulated category adjacent to ours. California chaptered two bills on 2026-09-09 — SB 813, which
defines an "independent verification organization" as an AI auditor designated by the Government
Operations Agency as having demonstrated expertise in assessing the risks posed by an AI system or
model, and directs that agency to establish the designation process on or before 1 January 2028; and
AB 1405, which directs the same agency to stand up an AI Auditor Registry no later than 1 January
2029, after which an unregistered person may not offer, sell or conduct a covered AI audit. Illinois
signed SB 315, the Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act, on 2026-07-06, effective 1 January
2027, which the state describes as making Illinois the first to require regular independent
third-party safety audits of covered AI systems. Sources: California's own bill text at
https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/billTextClient.xhtml?bill_id=202520260SB813 and
https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/billTextClient.xhtml?bill_id=202520260AB1405 ; the Illinois
Governor's own announcement at
https://gov-pritzker-newsroom.prezly.com/gov-pritzker-signs-nation-leading-artificial-intelligence-safety-law

Because that category now exists, a reader could infer that we hold a place in it. We do not.
Council of AI is an independent measurement board. WE HOLD NO CERTIFICATION, DESIGNATION,
REGISTRATION OR ACCREDITATION UNDER ANY SUCH SCHEME — not in California, not in Illinois, not
anywhere — AND WE HAVE NEVER APPLIED FOR ONE. Nothing we publish is an AI audit required by any
statute, and nothing we publish should be filed as one. We measure, we sign, we publish the method,
and determination stays with authorities. If that ever changes, this paragraph changes with it and
the change goes in the corrections ledger.

- Machine-readability & clarity record (signed): https://councilof.ai/api/clarity

## Come back / carry the mark

- What changed, as RSS: https://councilof.ai/feed.xml (aliases: https://councilof.ai/rss.xml ; https://councilof.ai/atom.xml ;
  canonical https://councilof.ai/api/feed.xml) — MEASURED board changes, REPORTED context,
  regulation-change events and corrections. Historical items keep their sitting-day wording and
  say so; counts typed there are superseded by the live board. No account, no email, no key.
- Badges you can paste: https://councilof.ai/badge.md — plain markdown, every snippet in the
  response body. Badges render live from GET /api/gspc, so a pasted badge cannot drift into a
  false claim; an unmeasured axis renders grey as "unmeasured", never as a flattering zero.
  There is no "certified" badge and there never will be.
- One-command MCP install: claude mcp add gspc -- npx -y csoai-gspc-mcp
- Python reader and card verifier: pip install "csoai-gspc[verify]"
